use default

lis(xs: int[]) -> Collections.List[int] is
    let n = xs.count
    let lengths = (0::n) |> map(_ => 1) |> collect_list()
    let prev = (0::n) |> map(_ => -1) |> collect_list()

    for i in 0..n do
        for j in 0..i do
            if xs[j] < xs[i] /\ lengths[j] + 1 > lengths[i] then
                lengths[i] = lengths[j] + 1
                prev[i] = j
            fi
        od
    od

    let best_index mut = 0

    for i in 0..n do
        if lengths[i] > lengths[best_index] then
            best_index = i
        fi
    od

    let result = LIST()
    let cur mut = best_index

    while cur >= 0 do
        result.add(xs[cur])
        cur = prev[cur]
    od

    result |> reverse() |> collect()
